title: Exploring Dual Agonists for PPARalpha/gamma Receptors using Pharmacophore Modeling, Docking Analysis and Molecule Dynamics Simulation.
authors: Ding, Ting-Ting; Liu, Ya-Ya; Zhang, Li-Ming; Shi, Jia-Rui; Xu, Wei-Ren; Li, Shao-Yong; Cheng, Xian-Chao
one_liner_zh: 该文用药效团建模、分子对接和分子动力学模拟筛选PPARα/γ双激动剂，虽涉及核受体转录因子配体结合，但核心是药物小分子-受体互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合，与本课题TF-DNA互作方向关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptors (PPARs) are ligandactivated transcription factors belonging to the nuclear receptor family. The roles of PPARalpha in fatty acid oxidation and PPARgamma in adipocyte differentiation and lipid storage have been widely characterized. Compounds with dual PPARalpha/gamma activity have been proposed, combining the benefits of insulin sensitization and lipid lowering into one drug, allowing a single drug to reduce hyperglycemia and hyperlipidemia while preventing the development of cardiovascular complications. METHODS: The new PPARalpha/gamma agonists were screened through virtual screening of pharmacophores and molecular dynamics simulations. First, in the article, the constructed pharmacophore was used to screen the Ligand Expo Components-pub database to obtain the common structural characteristics of representative PPARalpha/gamma agonist ligands. Then, the accepted ligand structure was modified and replaced to obtain 12 new compounds. Using molecular docking, ADMET and molecular dynamics simulation methods to screen the designed 12 ligands, analyze their docking scores when they bind to the PPARalpha/gamma dual targets, their stability and pharmacological properties when they bind to the PPARalpha/gamma dual targets. RESULTS: We performed pharmacophore-based virtual screening for 22949 molecules in Ligand Expo Components-pub database. The compounds that were superior to the original ligand were performed structural analysis and modification, and a series of compounds with novel structures were designed. Using precise docking, ADMET prediction and molecular dynamics methods to screen and verify newly designed compounds, and the above compounds show higher docking scores and lower side effects. CONCLUSION: 9 new PPARalpha/gamma agonists were obtained by pharmacophore modeling, docking analysis and molecular dynamics simulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs）是配体激活的转录因子，属于核受体家族。PPARalpha在脂肪酸氧化中的作用以及PPARgamma在脂肪细胞分化和脂质储存中的作用已被广泛表征。具有双重PPARalpha/gamma活性的化合物已被提出，将胰岛素增敏和降脂作用结合于一种药物中，使单一药物能够降低高血糖和高脂血症，同时预防心血管并发症的发生。方法：通过药效团虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟筛选新的PPARalpha/gamma激动剂。首先，在文章中，使用构建的药效团筛选Ligand Expo Components-pub数据库，以获得代表性PPARalpha/gamma激动剂配体的共同结构特征。然后，对接受的配体结构进行修饰和替换，获得12种新化合物。利用分子对接、ADMET和分子动力学模拟方法筛选设计的12种配体，分析它们与PPARalpha/gamma双靶点结合时的对接分数、稳定性及药理性质。结果：我们对Ligand Expo Components-pub数据库中的22949个分子进行了基于药效团的虚拟筛选。对优于原始配体的化合物进行结构分析和修饰，设计了一系列具有新颖结构的化合物。使用精确对接、ADMET预测和分子动力学方法筛选并验证新设计的化合物，上述化合物显示出更高的对接分数和更低的副作用。结论：通过药效团建模、对接分析和分子动力学模拟获得了9种新的PPARalpha/gamma激动剂。
